title: Search context policies using development labels and a call budget
description:
## Scope

Implement automated selection without requiring DSPy: evaluate candidate global demonstration sets and target-conditioned policy parameters on development data, with a declared metric, deterministic tie breaking, repeated seeds where applicable, and a maximum-call budget. Keep global-set search and per-target retrieval distinct in the resulting artifact.

## Definition of done

A scripted decision model proves search chooses by development performance, never requests scoreboard labels, resumes without duplicate successful calls, reports objective/call history, and stops at the ceiling.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Search context policies using development labels and a call budget
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given candidate policies, a labeled development split, a scripted model, and a call ceiling
    When the optimizer searches
    Then it freezes the development-selected policy without reading scoreboard labels or exceeding the ceiling
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Terra implementation reviewed against the acceptance scenarios. Independent offline suite passed 144 specs. Coverage includes nested balanced random/prototype/retrieval selection, custom-policy membership and target-exclusion guards, complete request fingerprints, independent presentation order and token estimates, development-only optimization, provisional versus frozen winner, cumulative scoped call accounting, and cache-only replay. No live provider calls or dataset downloads.
